summary: Frontend-only verification of the docked property card fix on Home Map screen. FIX CONFIRMED WORKING. Playwright (mobile 390x844, logged in as demo@amass.africa) reached route / (home-map-screen present) and found 9 rendered `docked-card-<id>` tiles — each 358x210 laid out at y=538 with the full expected content: image, Premium chip (top-left), Verified badge (bottom-left), share + favorite icons (top-right), ₦145M price, 'Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1' address, 'View Details' CTA, and meta row '5 bed · 6 bath · 620 m² · duplex'. `open-insights` CTA visible directly above the docked card (y=504, above the card at y=538) and tapping it opens the Neighborhood Intelligence bottom sheet with ALL required sections: Lifestyle Score hero (82 with Walkability/Schools/Safety/Infrastructure bars), Price Intelligence (₦/m² = ₦234k, area avg = ₦155M, vs area = -6.5%, appreciation = +8.2%/yr), Commute (5.8 km / 14 min drive), and What's nearby (Schools 2 km, Hospitals 0.6 km, Restaurants 0.7 km, Supermarkets 0.7 km). The `fab-layers` FAB (icon layers-outline) opens the Layer Picker sheet showing all 4 layer cards (Standard/Satellite/Hybrid/Terrain) plus the full Marker Legend (For Sale, For Rent, Short Let, Coming Soon, Sold, Commercial, Land, Verified/Premium). Only console noise on the Home Map screen is the pre-existing React Native Web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents, resizeMode, useNativeDriver) and one React 19 element.ref warning from @gorhom/bottom-sheet — same advisories carried over from iteration 7, not blocking. No red screen, no PAGEERROR, no runtime crash.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated (Use boxShadow)', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (Use style.pointerEvents)', 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated (Use props.resizeMode)', 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported'. Advisory-only on web; unchanged from iteration 7. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/MapDockedCard.tsx and other StyleSheets using shadow*.

Console error 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' fires when NeighborhoodSheet or LayerPickerSheet opens. Sheet still functions correctly. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/NeighborhoodSheet.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/LayerPickerSheet.tsx (@gorhom/bottom-sheet version needs React 19 compatible release).

action_items: No action required for the docked-card bug — the removal of `position: absolute` from MapDockedCard styles.container fixed the collapse; the FlatList now lays out at its intrinsic height (210px) inside the absolutely-positioned parent wrapper in (tabs)/index.tsx. Verified visually + via bounding-box measurement.

OPTIONAL POLISH (carried from iter 7): Migrate shadow* → boxShadow, style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents in MapDockedCard.tsx and neighbours to silence RNW warnings.
OPTIONAL: Bump @gorhom/bottom-sheet (and/or react-native-reanimated) to a React 19 compatible release to remove the element.ref console error.
critical_code_review_comments: MapDockedCard.tsx styles.container is intentionally empty now — the descriptive comment is retained which is good documentation. Consider removing the empty object and just using inline `style={{}}` or dropping the wrapping <View> altogether, since the parent already owns positioning; the extra wrapper only exists to hold pointerEvents='box-none' which itself is deprecated on web (should be style.pointerEvents).

(tabs)/index.tsx line 676 hard-codes `bottom: dockedBottom` (=68 + insets.bottom + 12 + 12) for the parent wrapper — this correctly clears the tab bar, but the value drifts if the tab-bar height changes. Consider centralising the tab-bar height in a shared constant.

The insights CTA at line 694 uses `bottom: dockedBottom + 214`. 214 is derived from the docked card's ~210px height + a small gap — if MapDockedCard height ever changes (e.g. imageWrap height 118 → 140 or more meta rows), the CTA will visually collide with the card. Consider measuring the docked card height dynamically (onLayout) instead of a magic offset.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: The outer <View style={styles.container}> inside /app/frontend/src/components/MapDockedCard.tsx had `position: absolute` with only `left: 0, right: 0` and no `top`/`bottom`/`height` — on React Native Web this collapses the flex parent to 0 height, so the child FlatList had no vertical space to render its horizontal row of cards and became invisible. Meanwhile the parent wrapper in (tabs)/index.tsx already owns the absolute positioning (`position:'absolute', left:0, right:0, bottom: dockedBottom`), so the inner absolute wrapper was doubly-absolute AND zero-height. FIX: removed `position: absolute` (and its left/right zeros) from styles.container, letting the FlatList lay out at its intrinsic 210px height inside the parent's absolute box. REPRODUCTION: Prior to fix, `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=docked-card-]')` returned 9 nodes but all with bounding_box height=0 (or the container's parent had no children in the layout tree). MITIGATION VERIFIED: after fix, bounding_box for docked-card-<id> = 358x210 at y=538 which is the expected position (just above the bottom tab bar).
